notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7); spending is listed by object only. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement Total column (pp9-10; same figures as the Statement of Activities business-type column, pp2-5); reported business receipts = Total Receipts + nonoperating interest (no single printed total). Fund balances (pp7-8) in the fund_balance fields; ending_cash = governmental Total Assets, all cash lines (p8); no beginning cash printed. Trim is missing report pages 26, 28 and 30 (right halves of the combining schedules: other governmental fund columns incl. Playground Equipment Fund, totals and budget columns, and the Sewer Fund column of the proprietary schedule). Detail: General, Street and Building funds from the governmental combining schedules (pp11-12); Playground Equipment Fund (interest 0.40, per p16 and the statement's Other Governmental column) not recorded since its schedule column is not in the trim. Light and Water funds from the proprietary budget schedule (pp13-14); Sewer Fund from the proprietary statement column (p9) because its schedule column is not in the trim. Budgets are printed only as per-fund disbursement totals (p12) or an all-fund proprietary column, so budget_final is null on lines. p16 combined unaudited summary repeats fund totals and is not recorded. Balance sheet: governmental from the governmental funds statement (p8; totals equal the Statement of Net Position governmental column), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1).
